name: Karen Khachanov
intro: Karen Khachanov is a tall tennis player from Moscow, Russia. He stands 6 feet 6 inches. He is famous for his huge serve and calm, quiet style.
story: Karen started tennis at age three in a kindergarten class. He decided to become a pro player when he was 12. In 2018 he won the Paris Masters and beat Novak Djokovic in the final. He won a silver medal at the Tokyo Olympics. This week he beat the No. 3 seed to reach the third round.

funFacts.text: He started playing tennis at age three in a kindergarten class.
He speaks three languages: Russian, English and Spanish.
He loved chemistry in school. He said the formulas 'danced around nicely' in his head.
Off the court he likes reading books and playing chess.
He won an Olympic silver medal at the Tokyo Games.
He cheers for Real Madrid in soccer and the Miami Heat in basketball.
He is a dad to two little boys.

watchFor: Watch his booming serve: he is 6 feet 6, so the ball comes down from way up high.
